d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ke aagami bihar daure ko lekar rajy sarkar ki taiyariyan tej ho gaee hain. is daure par bihar sarkar men mantri ramkripal yadav ka bayan samne aaya hai. midiya se batchit karte hue unhonne pradhanmantri ke svagat aur 'nitish setu' ke shubharanbh ko lekar rajy ke logon ke utsah ke bare men bat ki.
